Game Overview

Kingdom of Ninja puts players into a arcade experience centered on become a master ninja in Kingdom of Ninja, where quick reflexes and strategic thinking are your allies against a gauntlet of lethal traps and fierce monsters. With ten progressively challenging levels, the thrill escalates as you navigate each intricately designed kingdom. Are you agile enough to conquer them all?
